REV-1 [R5] R5 requires an unknown icon name to render nothing and not throw, and documentation/api.md and documentation/features.md promise exactly that. Because inherited Object.prototype keys are treated as built-in icons, a consumer passing an untrusted string (route param, API value) can crash the render tree or render a bogus empty icon. Guard with Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ZEST_ICON_ELEMENTS, name) (or use a Map/null-prototype object) before indexing.

REV-2 [EFF-001] The feature's non-functional performance requirement is that the built ESM bundle grow by no more than 15 KB; it grew by 15,912 bytes, exceeding the agreed size budget. Trim the icon additions (remove the unused duplicate icons, share one element for identical drawings such as export/download and import/upload, and drop the leftover comments) until the delta is within 15 KB, or record an approved budget change. Do not leave the requirement unmet.

REV-3 [DOC-001] The documentation's Icon column does not match the icon the code ships: a reader looking for the sliders glyph gets a target. Either draw sliders for `settings` or correct the documentation so the table describes the shipped icon.

REV-5 [USR-003] Unused import left over from the previous implementation; harmless but unnecessary. Remove it.
